searchText: Did we resolve the Kiln transition problem from yesterday? Im not sure if this is the problem you referring to, but Prsym produced bad blocks caused by a big vs. little endian issue in handling baseFeePerGas. The bugs are already fixed by the team. Was that the only issue from the transition? I stopped following before everything was figured out, and at the time it wasn't clear if there were multiple problems or not. About the Merge -> Paris rename. I'm glad this is resolved, but this is very late to decide on names. In my projects I'm already using Cancun for the upgrade after Shanghai. I will change the name to Paris but I wander if other projects will do (e.g. geth, tests). Isn't it London, (Arrow Glacier), Paris, Shanghai now? Where Paris is out of order, because the first Paris conf (EDCON) was after Shanghai? 😬 <timbeiko> > In my projects I'm already using Cancun I’m curious what “uses” there are for Cancun already given that Shanghai isn’t even fully spec’ed yet? <timbeiko> Yes, that’s correct. Paris isn’t in the right order, but there was already a lot of talk of Shanghai so it would have been more confusing to name the merge upgrade Shanghai 😅 (re @allcoredevs_bot: <axic> Isn't it London, (Arrow Glacier), Paris, Shanghai now? Where Paris is out of order, because the first Paris conf (EDCON) was after Shanghai? 😬) I'm using Cancun to prototype some EIPs that are too late for Shanghai. Could be named Experimental too. I just wanted to note that these names are introduced to code quite early in the process. So it has more value to know the names up front. Shanghai (feature fork) could still launch before Paris (merge), right <@!552133098075193354>? 😅 <timbeiko> That seems incredibly unlikely, no? We’d have to find something _so_ wrong with The Merge that we think it will take several quarters to fix, and then decide that getting Shanghai out is a better way forward... Not just unlikely, but a fate we are working very hard to avoid.
